title: Third appeal for my ban.

replies.author: ballzi
replies.body: I feel I have waited long enough too.
replies.body_tagged: I feel I have waited long enough too.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
You did a lot of immoral and irresponsible things in chat, and I appreciate you for owning up to it. I do think, however, that you aren't quite ready yet to return, and I'd suggest waiting one more month. Typically, for permanently banned players, we will appeal them upon the 5th/6th month of the active infraction. With all of your behavior combined especially from the general act you played prior, I think it's right to have you serve your sentence like the others.

Feel free to make another appeal later, if you wish: I'm not convinced now just yet to let you back. Thank you for your cooperation and patience, though.

Regards,
ViceWatercolour.
